name: ledger-engine
description: > A production-grade double-entry ledger in Node.js + PostgreSQL. > Built to demonstrate correctness under concurrency — the core problem of every fintech backend.

scripts.db: docker compose exec db psql -U ledger
scripts.db:tables: docker compose exec db psql -U ledger -c '\dt'
scripts.db:schema: docker compose exec db psql -U ledger -c '\d accounts' -c '\d transactions' -c '\d entries'
scripts.db:balances: docker compose exec db psql -U ledger -c "SELECT a.name, a.type, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.type IN ('asset','expense') THEN CASE WHEN e.direction='debit' THEN e.amount ELSE -e.amount END ELSE CASE WHEN e.direction='credit' THEN e.amount ELSE -e.amount END END), 0) AS balance FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN entries e ON e.account_id=a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.name, a.type ORDER BY a.type;"
